import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
i2,o2=G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']
# find added cells in demo2
added={(r,c) for r in range(12) for c in range(10) if o2[r][c]==4 and i2[r][c]!=4}
print(sorted(added))
fours2={(r,c) for r in range(12) for c in range(10) if i2[r][c]==4}
# hypothesis: two copies of shape placed vertically symmetric around the 6-shape's vertical center, columns shifted so that... 
# 4-bbox: rows1-4, cols2-5. 6-bbox: rows8-10, col4.
# added rows5-8 = reflection of shape about row 6.5? shape top row1 -> mirror row 12-1=11? no.
# try: mirror of shape placed such that its bottom (row4 originally) maps to row 9? mirror about row 6.5: r'=13-r -> row4->9,row1->12(out). Hmm rows5-8.
# Try translation + vertical flip anchored at 6-bbox bottom: original band rows1-4; 6 band rows8-10. distance =7. Flipped copy occupies rows 5..8 (band height 4, bottom at 8).
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    fill=max(cnt.items(), key=lambda kv:kv[1])[0]
    fours=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==fill]
    sixes=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==6]
    r4=min(r for r,c in fours); b4=max(r for r,c in fours)
    r6=min(r for r,c in sixes); b6=max(r for r,c in sixes)
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    def vflip(cells,top,bot):
        return [(top+bot-r,c) for r,c in cells]
    out=fours|{p for p in vflip(fours,r4,b4)}
    # upright copy top-aligned with top of 6 bbox: dr=r6-r4
    dr=r6-r4
    out|={(rr+dr,c) for rr,c in fours}
    for r,c in out:
        if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W: res[r][c]=fill
    for r,c in sixes: res[r][c]=0
    return res
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    four=max((c,n) for c,n in cnt.items() if c not in (0,6))[0]
    cells={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==four}
    sixes=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==6]
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    mr=[r for r,c in sixes][0]
    mc=(sum(c for r,c in sixes))/len(sixes)
    dr=(mr-(rs[-1]))>0 if len(rs)>0 else False
    dc=(mc-cs[-1])>0 if len(cs)>0 else False
    # extreme of shape in direction of marker
    if dr: ext=max(rs)   # go down
    elif dc: ext=max(cs)
    elif not dr: ext=min(rs)
    else: ext=min(cs)

    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for rr,cc in sixes: res[rr][cc]=0
    for r,c in cells:

        nc=(2*axis)-c if dc else c
        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W: res[nr][nc]=four
    return res
ok=True
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    m=f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output']
    ok&=m; print(k,m)
print('ALL',ok)
out=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))

import os,re,json

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    ops={'v':lambda p:(p[0],p[1]),      # vertical stack: flip rows

    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # try: flip across each axis, then translate so copy touches marker while staying in bounds
    for name,op in [('vm',lambda q:(q[0],q[1]))]:
        pts={op(q) for q in S}
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        mr=min(rs); mc=min(cs)
        # v-stack: shift down/up until touching marker rows
        def try_shift(rs0,cs0,dR):
            for tr in range(-H,H+1):
                R=[r+tr for r in rs0]
                if any(r<0 or r>=H for r in R): continue
                yield tr,R,cs0
        for name,op,shift_ax in [
            ('vm',lambda q:(-q[0],q[1]),'R'),
            ('hm',lambda q:(q[0],-q[1]),'C')]:
            pass
    return None

# Simpler: determine pull direction from whether shape and marker share rows/cols, slide flipped copy until nearest edges meet; verify demos
def f2(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

    rs=[r for r,c in S]; cs=[c for r,c in S]

    rmax=max(rs); cmax=max(cs)

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    S={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==4}
    M={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==6}
    rs=[p[0] for p in S]; cs=[p[1] for p in S]
    mrs=[p[0] for p in M]; mcs=[p[1] for p in M]
    T={'down':lambda q:(round(2*(max(rs)+0.5)-q[0]),q[1]),
       'up':lambda q:(round(2*(min(mrs)-0.5)-q[0]),q[1]),
       'right':lambda q:(q[0],round(2*(max(cs)+0.5)-q[1])),
       'left':lambda q:(q[0],round(2*(min(mcs)-0.5)-q[1]))}
    cands=[]
    sc=sum(rs)/len(rs); sc_=sum(cs)/len(cs)
    mc=sum(mrs)/len(mrs); mc_=sum(mcs)/len(mcs)
    for sgn,Tv in T.items():
        cover={Tv(q) for q in S}
        if not all(0<=Tv(q)[0]<H and 0<=Tv(q)[1]<W for q in S): continue
        if cover & M: continue
        disp = mc-sc if sgn in ('down','up') else mc_-sc_
        side_ok = (sgn=='down')!= (disp>0) or (sgn=='right')!=(disp_:=mc_-sc_>0)
        cands.append((sgn,side_ok,Tv))
    best=max(cands,key=lambda o:o[1])
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r,c in S: res[r][c]=4
    for r,c in S:
        rr,cc=best[2]((r,c))
        if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: res[rr][cc]=4
    for r,c in M:
        if (r,c) not in {best[2](q) for q in S}: res[r][c]=0
    return res
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    G={}
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    for p in glob.glob(d+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl'):
        t=open(p).read().replace('\\n','\n')
        for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
            k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
            rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
                G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
